description: Repository files ErgoptiPlus.app ships under Contents/Resources/static, at their repository-relative layout. Read by tools/build/macos-bundle-payload.cjs, the only stager, and judged by tools/test/test-macos-bundle-payload.cjs against every path the macOS runtime reads.

trees.reason: The Hammerspoon driver: MJConfigFile points at its init.lua, and every require, dofile and script path resolves inside it.
Shared Lua modules, WebView applications, locales, hotstrings, database schema and defaults, resolved through infra/paths.lua (Paths.shared).
Only the images the driver opens: the menu bar and notification logos (ui/menu/init.lua, infra/notifications.lua). The other images belong to the website and the Windows onboarding flags.

external.reason: The newest keyboard layout bundle, selected by version in tools/build/build_macos_app.sh.
The offline keyboard-layout registry, copied whole by tools/build/build_macos_app.sh.
The commit stamp the diagnostics read in a bundle without .git.
LuaSocket, which Hammerspoon does not ship, built for both architectures.
The native half of the bundled LuaSocket.
Generated conditionally from both genuine native producer archives and provenance receipts through the source-qualified catalogue owner; never committed.

exclude.reason: The Swift launcher is compiled into Contents/MacOS; its sources, package manifest and XCTests are never read by the running app.
Unit, meta, E2E and conformance suites, their fixtures and corpora, and the shared test contracts only run under tests/run.lua and the JS gates.
READMEs, specifications and configuration examples document the repository; no runtime path opens them. The third-party license notice ships with the vendored code it covers.
dSYM bundles only serve crash symbolication on a developer machine; dyld and Lua load the .so beside them.
Maintainer scripts that regenerate or validate committed data, and installer scripts no driver invokes.
